text: Hello everyone and welcome to live text coverage of the Premier League clash between Brighton and Hove Albion and Sheffield United.

Though occupying eighth place and fresh from complete a memorable Europa League double over Ajax in midweek, Brighton are struggling for form in the Premier League, failing to win any of their last five matches.
Also, the Seagulls have not beaten United at home in the league since May 1987.
As for United, they are bottom of the Premier League with just four points from their opening 11 games.
However, they are fresh from beating Wolves last weekend, and another victory here would lift the Blades out of the relegation zone.
Roberto De Zerbi makes six changes from Brighton's win over Ajax.
Goalscorers Fati and Adingra retain their places, as do Van Hecke, Gross and Dahoud.
James Milner, Lewis Dunk and Pervis Estupinan all miss out after limping off in midweek.
They join the likes of Julio Enciso, Danny Welbeck, Solly March and Tariq Lamptey in the treatment room.
Paul Heckingbottom makes just a single change from United's last-gasp win over Wolves.
It is an enforced one, too, with McAtee replacing the injured Rhian Brewster, who limped off last weekend with a knee injury.

Hamer shakes off a hamstring concern to start, but Oli McBurnie and Anel Ahmedhodzic remain on a lengthy injury list alongside the likes of Chris Basham, John Egan, Tom Davies, Rhys Norrington-Davies and Daniel Jebbison.
The teams are out and we are almost ready to go at the Amex Stadium.
The referee blows his whistle and United get the match under way!
Chance! Brighton go in search of an early goal and Fati has the opportunity to shoot from just inside the box.
But sends his attempt straight at Foderingham.
ADINGRA!!! 1-0 BRIGHTON! What a start by the hosts! They take the lead in the sixth minute as Adingra cuts inside from the left and embarks on a strong run towards the penalty area.
He then plays a neat one-two with Buonanotte before slotting past Foderingham.
Buonanotte provided a neat return pass for Adingra to apply the finishing touch and break the deadlock.
There is a concern for the visitors as Foderingham stayed down and was in need of attention following that goal.
However, the goalkeeper is eventually cleared to continue.
The Blades arrived today as the only Premier League side yet to register a point on the road this season.
They will have to come from behind here in order to stop the rot.
Brighton have scored for a 12th successive Premier League game.
But they will now be hoping they avoid conceding in a 12th successive Premier League game.
Liverpool were the last team to do that in the English top flight, doing so in 1966-67.
GOOD SAVE! Brighton suddenly open up the United defence with Fati latching onto Buonanotte's throughball.
However, Foderingham produces a smart reflex save to deny him.
Although United trail, their deficit could have been greater had it not been for Foderingham, who has already produced a couple of decent saves to deny Fati.
Heckingbottom watches on from the sidelines as Brighton neatly maintain possession and look to build momentum towards a second goal.
The Blades need to respond.
Brighton are still a goal to the good as we hit the midway point in this first half.
The hosts are certainly good value for their advantage, enjoying around three-quarters of the possession.
United have never lost against Brighton in their four previous Premier League meetings.
Of course, they must come from behind today to keep that run going.
Brighton look to turn up the pressure as they send a dangerous free-kick into the box.
But the United defence are alert and just about manage to clear their lines.
Chance! Robinson fails to clear a cross and the ball breaks kindly for Buonanotte in the box.
But he can only fire wide of the right post.
Brighton continue to search for that second goal and Lallana looks to play Fati in behind the defence.
But the latter is thwarted by the raising of the offside flag.
United look to respond and threaten an equaliser through a free-kick and long throw.
But Brighton deal with the danger on both occasions.
There is a break in play with Vinicius going down and in need of treatment following that long throw.
The medical team are on to tend to the United midfielder, who appeared to be holding his back.
After receiving attention from the medical team, it looks like Vinicius will be fine to continue here.
The last thing United will want is yet another injury.
United with the opportunity to threaten an equaliser as Igor puts the ball behind for a corner.
Can the visitors make the most of this?
The corner leads to Bogle trying his luck from distance.
But his ambitious attempt is off target and not troubling Steele in the Brighton goal.
The visitors have another opportunity to get the ball into the box after Dahoud is penalised for a foul on McAtee.
Can they capitalise on this chance?
Nothing comes of the free-kick as Brighton remain fully concentrated at the back.
We are going to play five additional minutes at the end of this first half.
Bogle receives the first yellow card of the game after catching Adingra with a late sliding challenge.
Good effort! Foderingham is alert and punches a free-kick clear.
It goes to Gilmour and the ball sits up nicely for him 30 yards from goal.
His dipping volley is on target and the goalkeeper is forced to tip it over the crossbar.
Buonanotte drags back Hamer and prevents him from potentially launching a counter.
The Brighton man goes into the book.
United look to equalise in the dying seconds of the first half.
McAtee has a shot blocked before Baldock's attempt is too high and not troubling Steele.
HALF-TIME: BRIGHTON 1-0 SHEFFIELD UNITED
Brighton lead Sheffield United by a goal to nil at the Amex Stadium.
The hosts made a bright start and took the lead after just six minutes when Simon Adingra played a neat one-two with Facundo Buonanotte before slotting past Wes Foderingham.
Roberto De Zerbi's side have certainly been good value for their lead so far.
Can the visitors respond in the second half? The Blades did register four shots during the opening 45 minutes, but not one of them was on target.
They must address that upon the restart.
Brighton make two changes at the break.
The first sees Buonanotte, who assisted the opening goal, replaced by Joao Pedro.
Lallana is also given a breather by De Zerbi.
He is replaced on the left flank by Mitoma.
We are off and running again in the second half.
United have lost 23 of their last 26 away games in the Premier League.
Can they turn things around in this second half?
Norwood catches Gilmour with a strong challenge in the centre of the field.
But the Blades skipper avoids any further punishment.
Close! Joao Pedro brilliantly holds up a long ball before feeding Adingra out wide.
The centre-forward receives the return pass, but cannot keep his first-time shot down.
United are forced into a change early in the second half.
Vinicius, who picked up a knock during the opening 45 minutes, makes way for Osborn.
There is a slight pause to check a possible penalty after Brighton claim Mitoma's cross came off Bogle's arm.
But the referee eventually signals for play to resume from a corner for the hosts.
United push for the equaliser with Baldock well found in the box.
He looks to square the ball for a team-mate, but none of them react quickly enough to connect with his centre.
ALMOST! Gross sends a deep corner towards the far post, where Van Hecke arrives.
The centre-half nods the ball into the ground, but it bounces up and over the crossbar.
GOOD SAVE! After loose possession, Brighton look to quickly counter.
Fati swiftly finds Mitoma on the left.
The latter skips away from a challenge and gets a shot away from a tight angle, but Foderingham turns it behind for a corner.
Although Foderingham punches a Brighton corner clear, the ball drops kindly for Dahoud.
He tries his luck from distance and his long-range attempt is on target, but Foderingham is alert and pushes it away.
Brighton continue to push for the second goal and Gross looks to release Mitoma with a throughball, but the latter is ruled offside.
Adingra has his name taken following a tangle with Thomas.
RED CARD FOR DAHOUD! Brighton are down to 10 men! The midfielder is shown a straight red card after he appeared to stamp on Osborn's ankle.
It did look accidental to be fair, but it was endangering his opponent.
De Zerbi responds by making a couple of substitutions.
One of those sees Gilmour make way to be replaced by Baleba.
Fati is also given a breather as he is replaced by Veltman in a very defensive change by the hosts.
That red card has made things very interesting here.
Suddenly, United have the numerical advantage and that will encourage them to push for an equaliser.
Can they find it?
OWN-GOAL!!! 1-1! Webster puts through his own net! The extra man immediately pays dividends for United.
The visitors look buoyant and after he is well found, Bogle drills the ball across the six-yard box, where Webster's attempt to clear sees him send the ball into his own net.
Suddenly, we are all square heading into the final quarter of an hour at the Amex Stadium.
Brighton appeared to be in control until Dahoud's red card, and United wasted no time in capitalising on having the extra man.
Baleba catches McAtee late and has his name taken by the referee.
CHANCE! Almost for the Blades! McAtee leads the charge as he feeds the ball into Archer, whose clever flick sets up Bogle.
But the latter drags his shot wide of the left post.
What a goal that would have been!
Although United have looked more dangerous, Brighton are also demonstrating their lack of interest in settling for a draw.
The hosts are looking to attack whenever they can and ask questions of their opponents' defence.
The Blades look to work their way into the Brighton box with a neat move.
But a timely intervention enables the hosts to clear their lines.
United's hunger and desire is evident as they press for what could be the winning goal.
The ball breaks kindly for Thomas, but his long-range attempt is always rising.
McAtee picks up a knock and is unable to continue.
Heckingbottom is taking no chances as he introduces Ben Slimane for the last five minutes.
Just three minutes remain at the Amex Stadium.
Can either side find a dramatic winning goal, or are we set for a stalemate here?
Robinson goes into the book after catching Joao Pedro late.
He will have to tread carefully now.
United enjoy a neat spell of possession as they look to fashion an opportunity to score a winner.
Bogle tries his luck from distance, but his attempt is straight at Steele.
Brighton are awarded a free-kick right on the edge of the penalty as we enter the first of five additional minutes at the end of this game.
Thomas trips Baleba and this is a decent chance for the hosts.
A free-kick is floated deep into the United area, but the visitors do well to maintain their concentration levels and deal with the danger.
A late concern for the visitors with Bogle staying down and in need of attention.
They will ready a substitute for just in case he is unable to continue.
Bogle limps towards the touchline and is replaced for the final few seconds by Osula.
FULL-TIME: BRIGHTON 1-1 SHEFFIELD UNITED
It finishes all square at the Amex Stadium, where Brighton and Sheffield United play out a 1-1 draw.
The hosts made a bright start and took the lead in the sixth minute through Simon Adringra and they were good value for their advantage.
But the pendulum swung in United's favour in the 69th minute when Mahmoud Dahoud was shown a straight red card for a stamp on Ben Osborn.
The visitors capitalised on their numerical disadvantage within five minutes as Adam Webster turned Jayden Bogle's cross into his own net.
It is a goal that lifts the Blades off the bottom of the Premier League table, while Brighton remain eighth.
Both sides are back in action on November 25 when Brighton travel to Nottingham Forest and United host Bournemouth.
Thank you for joining us today.
Until next time, goodbye!
